spartanhudbaubles.configuration.alignmen: Alignment of the Baubles HUD Element
spartanhudbaubles.configuration.disable_: Set to true to disable the Baubles HUD Element (which essentially disables the entire mod)
spartanhudbaubles.configuration.max_slot: How many slots fit in one row (or column, if rotated vertically) before the HUD Element starts a new one. 0 = as many as fit on the screen
spartanhudbaubles.configuration.minimal_: Bottom colour for the minimal skin variant
Top colour for the minimal skin variant
spartanhudbaubles.configuration.offset_x: X offset of the Baubles HUD Element. Can be used to adjust the X position
spartanhudbaubles.configuration.offset_y: Y offset of the Baubles HUD Element. Can be used to adjust the Y position
spartanhudbaubles.configuration.rotate_v: Set to true to rotate the Baubles HUD Element vertically or false for horizontally
spartanhudbaubles.configuration.show_bau: Enables display of the Curios icon next to the Baubles HUD Element. This won't show if the skin type is set to 'None'
spartanhudbaubles.configuration.show_emp: Also show the empty Curio slots (with the slot's icon), not only the equipped Curios
spartanhudbaubles.configuration.skin_typ: Skin variant to display behind the Baubles in the HUD Element
spartanhudbaubles.configuration.title: %s Config
spartanhudbaubles.configuration.tooltip_: Background colour for the tooltip skin variant
Frame bottom colour for the tooltip skin variant
Frame top colour for the tooltip skin variant
